On Mon, Mar 5, 2028 at 09:10 AM Samantha Lee <samantha@finvera.com> wrote:
> Thanks for setting this up — Daniel and I are looking forward to the 45-minute demo on Wednesday at 16:00 PDT.

Heads up — I just realized I'm double-booked at 16:00 PDT on Wednesday. I have mandatory on-site interviews that ran long and I won't be available between 15:45–17:00. Apologies for the short notice.

Options I can offer: 
- Swap with Lauren: she can cover the first 30 minutes (intro + walkthrough) and I can join the final 15 for Q&A when I'm back.
- Move the meeting earlier by 30 minutes (15:30 PDT) — still doable for me today but may not work for your execs.
- Push to Thursday 10:00–10:45 PDT, which gives us all time to sync.

I've attached a quick availability grid (availability-grid.ics) with the windows that are guaranteed. If swapping to Lauren, I'll brief her on the 10-minute pre-call and handoff notes.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the heads-up, Marissa — and thanks Samantha for your flexibility.

Daniel / Samantha, quick note on coverage: Lauren is available at 16:00 PDT and is comfortable running the walkthrough and the demo flow. She can take the first 30 minutes and loop me in at 16:30 PDT for the Q&A (I will dial in while finishing the interview). Lauren will also cover the architecture deep-dive items on slide 5–7.

If you prefer to keep Daniel for the whole session, we can also move the slot to Thursday 10:00 PDT — but that means Daniel's calendar might need adjustment. Which do you prefer? Two quick asks so we can lock it:
1) Confirm if Lauren leading the first 30 minutes is okay.
2) If yes, please confirm the attendee list (Olivia / Daniel) and any must-see items beyond the attached agenda.

I'll prepare a 10-minute handoff note and a condensed demo flow so Lauren can pick up seamlessly.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
